title: Nex Anthracite

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The Bilmola Nex Anthracite is engineered for warm-weather riding with featherweight crown comfort, pairing 180-degree panoramic sightlines with certified cranial protection. Built around a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell weighing a featherweight 1138g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~98 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across DOT benchmarks. The interior features a plush, moisture-wicking crown liner shaped for Intermediate Oval head shapes, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for effortless warm-weather riding.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.

Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

introduction: Positioned in Bilmola's Open Face lineup, the Nex Anthracite brings Global Premium engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT track safety.
story:
The Bilmola Nex Anthracite represents Bilmola's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~98 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Open Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Bilmola Nex Anthracite delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
